name: Sardegna Turismo
verdict: The 'Sardegna' branding on the Cagliari front shirt is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, run by its regional tourism department….
note: Proposed rating: serious. The link is the region's tourism department; the record is Italy's migration-control abuses. Needs a maintainer to set the tier and review the why. The Autonomous Region of Sardinia is typed 'state' and linked to the Italian state (italian-republic) as its parent, the state the region belongs to. Doppio Malto was split out into its own record on the 2026-27 kit.

why.text: The 'Sardegna' front brand is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia. The region is a public body of the Italian state, whose migration-control model has unlawfully detained migrants and asylum seekers and obstructed rescues at sea.
